support_button.title: Support Me
support_button.description: Encore Tweaks is, and always will be, free for you, and everyone. You can however show me that you care by making a donation.

learn_encore.title: Learn Encore
learn_encore.description: Learn how to use Encore Tweaks and its features.

lite_mode.title: Enforce Lite Mode
lite_mode.description: Enable Lite Mode by default for all games

device_mitigation.title: Device Mitigation
device_mitigation.description: Mitigate device specific issues on Encore Tweaks

log_level.title: Log Level
log_level.description: Choose how detailed the Encore Tweaks operational log should be

create_shortcut.title: Create Shortcut
create_shortcut.description: Create a home screen shortcut for quick access to Encore Tweaks

disable_tweaks.title: Disable Tweaks
disable_tweaks.description: Disable all performance tweaks set by Encore Tweaks, useful for addon-only users.

game_settings.title: Game Settings
game_settings.lite_mode_description: Lower frequency requests for this game.
game_settings.dnd_mode_description: Block notifications and calls while gaming
game_settings.target_fps_description: Default uses per-game fas-rs candidates. Optional fixed target must match your game settings.

lite_mode.title: Lite Mode
lite_mode.brief: Lite mode reduces overheating and power consumption during gameplay by lowering CPU and component frequencies. This setting applies to all games when enabled.

disable_tweaks.title: Disable Tweaks
disable_tweaks.brief: When enabled, this setting turns off all built-in performance optimizations on Encore Tweaks, allowing you to use this module strictly as a host for Encore Addon modules.

device_mitigation.title: Device Mitigation
device_mitigation.brief: Device mitigation disables potentially incompatible tweaks for specific devices. Keep it disabled unless you have problems.

cpu_governor.title: CPU Governor
cpu_governor.default_description: Applied to balanced and performance profiles when lite mode is active
cpu_governor.powersave_description: Exclusively used for the powersave profile
cpu_governor.brief: CPU governor is an algorithm that dynamically adjusts the processor's frequency in real time, directly affecting system performance and power consumption.

modal.performance_warning: Setting the governor to "performance" will cause overheating and rapid battery drain. Are you sure you want to proceed?
modal.initial_warn: Please note that Encore Tweaks has automatically configured the optimal CPU Governor. Manual changes are not recommended unless you are an advanced user.

reboot_modal.title: Reboot Required
reboot_modal.description: This change requires a reboot to take effect. Would you like to reboot now?

toast.reboot_to_apply: Reboot your device to apply changes.
toast.shortcut_unavailable: No API available for this feature, use WebUI X to use this feature.

pixel.high_fps_desc: Allow high frame rates in foreground games. Restore the original policy when you leave. Game support and system limits still apply.
pixel.lite_desc: Use lower CPU, GPU and memory frequency requests for every registered game. The 41°C Lite protection still applies when this is off.
pixel.disabled_desc: Release the module’s frequency requests and restore the original frame-rate policy. The service stays running.
pixel.fas_desc: Use upstream fas-rs frame capture and CPU control through Pixel frequency votes. Off releases feedback requests.
pixel.fas_rs_advisor_desc: Enable the fas-rs proportional adviser while keeping Encore's own frame feedback active.
pixel.game_lite_desc: Lower frequency requests for this game.
pixel.save_error: Could not save; your change was not applied. Reload and retry.
